description.message: Opens Redmine issue links in the Refined Redmine app.

handoffHint.message: If the browser asks, allow it to open Refined Redmine (tick “Always allow” so it does not ask again). This tab closes by itself once the app opens.

redmineUrl.message: Redmine address (the same one set in the app)

autoOpen.message: Open in the app the issue links clicked outside the browser (Slack, e-mail…)

autoOpenHint.message: Links followed inside Redmine stay in the browser. The extension button and the right-click menu on issue links open them in the app at any time.
